_comment: ICU data profiles (docs/design/text-fonts.md, 'ICU and binary size'). tools/icu_data.py builds a filtered icudt library from the prebuilt ICU data package. 'languages' are language subtags kept in every locale tree (root is always kept); '*' keeps all. Converters are always reduced to the ones WebCore asks ICU for: TextCodecICU.cpp's encodings and every ucnv_open("...") in WebCore/WTF (EncodingTables.cpp builds the CJK decoders' tables from EUC-JP, Big-5, windows-949 and gb18030). Segmentation dictionaries are kept: removing them breaks line breaking for those scripts on any page, whatever the UI language.

converters_missing_upstream._comment: WebCore encodings with no converter even in the stock ICU data package; tools/icu_data.py fails if any other encoding is unmatched.
converters_missing_upstream.iso-8859-16: Not in ICU 79.1's default data (stock icudt79l.dat has no iso-8859_16 table).
